# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 虞舜居嬀汭，因以爲氏。从女爲聲。
As per 堯# (arch/rise high) + 女 woman → lithesome woman (← tall and supple) → *graceful*; *tease*.
苛也。一曰擾、戲弄也，一曰嬥也。从女堯聲。
喜# joy + 女 woman → woman enjoying herself or amusing others → *enjoy*; *be glad/happy/delighted*.
As per 單# (fanning motion) + 女 woman → the sinewy motion of a female → *delicate beauty*; *graceful*.
嬋娟，態也。从女單聲。
喬# tall and limber + 女 woman → woman twisting her body alluringly (compare 妖) → *coquetry*; *seductiveness*.
姿也。从女喬聲。
敏疾也。一曰莊敬皃。从女僉聲。
女黑色也。从女會聲。《詩》曰：“嬒兮蔚兮。”
便嬖、愛也。从女辟聲。
緩也。从女亶聲。一曰傳也。
Abbreviated form# of 牆 fence/wall + 女 woman → enclosure for females of the court → *female retainer*; *female servant*.
婦官也。从女，牆省聲。
材緊也。从女瞏聲。《春秋傳》曰：“嬛嬛在疚。”
直好皃。一曰嬈也。从女翟聲。
女字也。从女與聲。讀若余。
As per 賓# (contact) + 女 woman → (Imperial) concubine or *court lady* (in both cases, in close contact with their superior). Also, *wife* (in close contact with her consort). Compare 妃.
服也。从女賓聲。
As per 需# (soft) + 女 woman → soft/supple woman (compare 嫩) → *mistress*; *concubine*. Also, *wife* and *weak*.
弱也。一曰下妻也。从女需聲。
好也。从女厭聲。
遟鈍也。从女臺聲。闒嬯亦如之。

賏# is an abbreviated form of 賡 (continue without interruption) + 貝 shell → string of shells, made into a necklace. 嬰 adds 女 woman → shell necklace extending about a woman's neck → *extend about*. *Baby* and (musical) *sharp* are borrowed meanings.
頸飾也。从女、賏。賏，其連也。
娚# a variant form of 喃 chatter + 男 man → chatter with a man → *play with*; *flirt*; *tease*. Compare 嫐.
少昊氏之姓也。从女，羸省聲。
說也。从女興聲。
媟嬻也。从女賣聲。
好也。从女𡚇聲。讀若蜀郡布名。
As per 賴# (sharp reduction) + 女 woman → *languid*; *lazy*; *listless* (← condition of a woman with sharply reduced energy).
懈也，怠也。一曰臥也。从女賴聲。
女字也。从女燕聲。
As per 霜# (facing pillars) + 女 woman → *widow* (likened to one in a pair of pillars left standing).
女字也。从女霝聲。
竦身也。从女簋聲。讀若《詩》“糾糾葛屨”。
As per 襄# (supple/soft) + 女 woman → supple *young lady* → *daughter*; *honorific for an unmarried woman*. Compare 娘.
煩擾也。一曰肥大也。从女襄聲。
As per 韱# (slender/fine) + 女 woman → *slender*; *delicate*; *fine* (← slender woman).
銳細也。从女韱聲。
愚戇多態也。从女巂聲。讀若隓。
As per 䜌# as described in 戀 (stretch) + 女 woman → *bewitching* stretching movements of a female → *charming*.
慕也。从女䜌聲。
謹也。从女屬聲。讀若人不孫爲孎。

子 is the single remaining form of two distinct oracle bone depictions of a small child . One shows a small child, while the second shows a child with rapidly growing hair → *child*; *son*; *boy*; *person*; *suffix appended to small objects*. Conceptually, a child was understood as one of a figurative pile of offspring. *Rat* (as the first sign of the Chinese zodiac), *north*, and *11 P.M. to 1 A.M.* are borrowed meanings. The Old Chinese readings of the two glyphs featured different vowels.
十一月，陽气動，萬物滋，人以爲偁。象形。凡子之屬皆从子。(李陽冰曰：“子在襁緥中，足併也。”)

A depiction of a child (compare 子) with its right arm cut off (compare 孒). The compound 孑孒 originally indicated "short" or "lacking," but the same compound (with a different reading) also refers to mosquito larvae.
無右臂也。从了，乚象形。

A depiction of a child (compare 子) with its left arm cut off (compare 孑). The compound 子孒 originally indicated "short" or "lacking," but the same compound (with a different reading) also refers to mosquito larvae.
無左臂也。从了，丿象形。

The relevant seal inscription form is 子 child + a mark# → mother and newborn (just passed through the vagina in being born), connected by the curving and now stretched umbilical cord → *hole* (← vagina). *Confucius* is a borrowed meaning.
通也。从𠃉从子。𠃉，請子之候鳥也。𠃉至而得子，嘉美之也。古人名嘉字子孔。
A depiction of a pregnant woman, her belly protruding (compare 巳) → *pregnancy*.
褢子也。从子从几。

子# child/offspring + 宀 roof/building → place in which to *raise* and increase the number of children* → *character* (← make one character after another by combining different elements) → *letter* → *small administrative unit* of a town/village (← small unit ← letter/character as one unit of a whole).
乳也。从子在宀下，子亦聲。

The relevant seal inscription form combines an abbreviated form# of 在 exist + 子 child → *existence* represented by children/descendants (compare 孫)→ *keep*/settle (in place) (← maintain existence) → *know* (← have knowledge of what exists).
恤問也。从子才聲。
As per 爪# (pick/pluck) + 子 child → scoop up and envelop a child in protection (compare 保) → *encase*; *nourish*. Also, *brood over eggs*. *Sincere* is a borrowed meaning.
卵孚也。从爪从子。一曰信也。

Originally, 八# split right and left + an element combining 屮 grass shoot and 子 child/offspring → young living things bursting upward and outward → *spring up* (compare 撥). The compound 孛星 refers to a comet.
𢍚也，从𣎵；人色也，从子。《論語》曰：“色孛如也。”
子# child + 攵 action indicator → be *diligent* in attending to a child → *industrious*.
汲汲也。从攴子聲。《周書》曰：“孜孜無怠。”
耂 an abbreviated form# of 老 (aged person) + 子 child → child(ren) attending to an aged person → *filial piety*.
善事父母者。从老省，从子。子承老也。

As per 皿# (cover an object) + 子 child → child energetically throwing off a cover (whether actual or figurative) and making a *beginning*. Also, *eldest sibling* (← energetic growth) → *big/great*. *Mencius/Mengzi* is via an abbreviation of 孟子.
長也。从子皿聲。

禾# grain/rice + 子 child (→ offspring) → seasonal activity (whereby grains are planted, cultivated and harvested, in conjunction with leaving the earth fallow in winter) → *season* → *three-month cycle*. For the idea of conceptual cycles, compare 期 and 週.
少偁也。从子，从稚省，稚亦聲。
As per 瓜# (solitary) + 子 child → a *solitary* child (compare 寡) → *(a)lone*; *orphan*.
無父也。从子瓜聲。

奴# female servant + 子 child → child of a (or, one's own) concubine → *wife and children* (as opposed to the master of the house, the husband) → *punish the wife and children along with the convicted criminal*. *Slave* and *servant* are atavistic meanings.
謹也。从三子。凡孨之屬皆从孨。讀若翦。
As per 亥# (stretched taut) + 子 child → *baby* suckling at a taut, milk-filled breast → *babyish*; *immature*.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character combines 子 child and 幺 here an abbreviated form# of the middle element described in 胤 (posterity) → *descendants* manifesting a family's lineage (compare 存) → *grandchild* (← child/children of one's child). A bronzeware inscription form replaces 幺 with 糸 thread, while a seal inscription form further refines the character by replacing 糸 with 系 connection, emphasizing familial continuity.
子之子曰孫。从子从系。系，續也。

As per the right-hand element/ 享# as described in 惇 (swarm within an enclosure) + an abbreviated form of 巩 as described in 恐 (connect objects) → build a (curved) enclosing wall connecting the opposite ends of an enclosure. *Who*, *which*, and *in any case* are borrowed meanings.

孖 is 子 child (doubled) → twins. 孨 combines 孖 and 子 → many small (and weak) children. In 孱, which adds 尸 (body), 孨 acts as a variant form of 孫 (small child) → *small* of body → *weak*; *frail* → *weaken*.
迮也。一曰呻吟也。从孨在尸下。
As per 茲# (luxuriant growth) + 子 child → *bear (large numbers of) children*; *be luxuriant*; *increase*.
汲汲生也。从子兹聲。
盛皃。从孨从曰。讀若薿薿。一曰若存。
As per 孚# (envelop/enclose) + 卵 egg → envelop an egg in incubating it → *incubate*; *hatch*.

𦥯# is 爻 (obtain knowledge) + an element combining a pair of hands and 冖 a cover (→ covered building) → covered place of instruction where another is stimulated to obtain knowledge (compare 校). 學 adds 子 child → place where an instructor stimulates pupils to acquire knowledge (compare 敎) → *school* → *study*; *learn*.
As per 需# (soft) + 子 child → (unweaned) *child*; *child* in a general sense.
乳子也。一曰輸也，輸尚小也。从子需聲。

As per 辥# as described in 櫱 (cut grass/vegetation) + 子 child (→ offspring) → *second growth vegetation* (such as from a freshly cut stump; compare 臬) → *child born to a concubine* → *misfortune* (← misfortune to be born to a concubine).
庶子也。从子辥聲。
As per 䜌# as described in 戀 (tangled) + 子 child → *twins* (← twins entangled in the womb).
一乳兩子也。从子䜌聲。

An abbreviated form of the covering element of a particular character, the shared final -N suggesting that the most likely candidates are 寒, 宴, 安, 賓 and 寅. In these and other dual-element characters 宀 suggests a roof, one concealing the contents of a building → *roof*; *building*.
交覆深屋也。象形。凡宀之屬皆从宀。
A depiction of a tall pile of goods in a storehouse (compare 倉, 藏 and 庄) → *store* (v.) → *stand tall/still* (← stationary pile).
辨積物也。象形。凡宁之屬皆从宁。
㪔也。从宀，人在屋下，無田事。《周書》曰：“宮中之穴食。”
A depiction of a long *snake* (compare 也) → stretch; be elongated. *Other* is a borrowed meaning.
虫也。从虫而長，象冤曲垂尾形。上古艸居患它，故相問無它乎。凡它之屬皆从它。
姦也。外爲盜，内爲宄。从宀九聲。讀若軌。

The relevant seal inscription form of 乇 depicts a hand raising an object in the palm straight up, separating the object from others . 宅 is as per 乇# (separate) + 宀 roof/building → be separated from others in being confined to a *residence* → *be/stay at home*.
所託也。从宀乇聲。
As per 于# (U-shaped) + 宀 roof/building → large, curving roof/eaves → *the heavens/universe*. Compare 宙.
屋邊也。从宀于聲。《易》曰：“上棟下宇。”

Originally, 又# hand/action indicator + a covering element → enclose/surround to *defend* or *protect* → *guard*; *watch* → *govern*; *observe* (a tradition); *maintain* (a position); *keep* (one's word); *stick to*. Also, *protector*, *keeper* and *babysitter*. Later, 又 was replaced by 寸, also a hand/action indicator.
守官也。从宀从寸。寺府之事者。从寸。寸，法度也。
宀# roof/building + 女 woman → woman resting/at ease indoors → *be at ease/peace* → *cheap*; *inexpensive* (← cheap enough to be purchased with ease).
靜也。从女在宀下。
An abbreviated form# of 宗 (mausoleum) + 木 tree/wood → wooden structure dedicated to ancestors. *Song dynasty* (C.E. 960-1279) is a borrowed meaning.
居也。从宀从木。讀若送。
As per 元# (round) + 宀 roof/building → be surrounded completely → *complete*; *fulfill*; *end*.
全也。从宀元聲。古文以爲寬字。
A variant form of 肉 *meat*.
As per 厷# as described in 雄 (extend) + 宀 roof/building → extensive parameters of a building → *wide*; *vast*; *grand*. Compare 弘.
屋深響也。从宀厷聲。
所安也。从宀之下，一之上，多省聲。
必 here an abbreviated form# of 閟 (shut tight) + 宀 roof/building → *silence*/*quiet* pervading a tightly shut building → *secret*.
安也。从宀必聲。
宗廟宔祏。从宀主聲。
石# stone + 宀 roof/building → *cave* used as a stone quarry. *Selfish* and *willful* are borrowed meanings.
過也。一曰洞屋。从宀，碭省聲。汝南項有宕鄉。
屋響也。从宀弘聲。

宀 roof/building + 示# altar/the supernatural → mausoleum with an altar, where the deified souls of ancestors are linked with their descendants (compare 祉) → *founder* → *religion* (← believers gathering about an altar) → *sect*; *branch*.
尊祖廟也。从宀从示。

The relevant oracle bone form of 㠯 is a depiction of objects that have been accumulated and wrapped. 官 adds 宀 roof/building → a number of people wrapped about/enclosed in an (official) building → *government*; *official* → *human organ* (← object controlling a variety of functions, in the manner of an official). Compare 營.
吏，事君也。从宀从𠂤。𠂤猶眾也。此與師同意。
As per 由# (pass/run through) + 宀 roof/building → *the heavens*, likened to an arch passing through the sky (compare 宇) → *space*; *the air*.
舟輿所極覆也。从宀由聲。

Variant# of 正 (straight) + 宀 roof/building → stand straight upright (fixed in place) in a building → *fix in place*; *settle*; *settle down*; *set* (a date); *determine*; *decide* (← fixity) → *rule*; *regulation*; *law*; *fate*; *destiny* (← fixed rules/destiny). Also, *sure* and *certain* (← correctness/certainty of a decision taken, or of a rule).
安也。从宀从正。

The relevant seal inscription form shows two figures bending beneath a cover (compare 丸) → *bend* (= make the body round) in concealment → *wind*. *As if*, *just like*, *addressed (to)* and *allotment* are borrowed meanings. In derivative characters, 宛 exerts either the conceptual influence "bend" (婉 惋 捥 etc.) or "circular" ( 埦 椀 碗 etc.).
屈草自覆也。从宀夗聲。
The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 宀 roof/building + 多# (originally, piled meat) → tall, neat pile of meat in a room → *good*; *right* (← neat).
As per 各# (come to a stop) + 宀 roof/building → stop to rest in a covered structure → *guest*; *customer* → *traveler*; *freeloader*.
寄也。从宀各聲。
As per 亘# (circle about) + 宀 roof/building → circle about a structure in proclaiming → *announce*; *state*.
天子宣室也。从宀𠄢聲。

至# stopping point + 宀 roof/building → *room*/chamber representing a stopping point (i.e. leading on to no other rooms) in a *house* → *deep cavern* (compare 窒); *cellar* → *greenhouse*. Also, *dynastic family* (compare 家).
實也。从宀从至。至，所止也。

As per 有# (extend) + 宀 roof/building → extend hospitality by offering a person shelter → *tolerate/indulge* (another person's shortcomings) (← provide figurative coverage for another person's needs/weaknesses) → *soothe*; *calm*.
寬也。从宀有聲。
As per 宀 roof/building + 臣# subject; retainer → palace servant → *government official*; *serve*.
仕也。从宀从臣。
養也。室之東北隅，食所居。从宀𦣞聲。
屋所容受也。从宀成聲。
羣居也。从宀君聲。
宀 roof/building + two squares indicating particular places within a building → winding building with many rooms → (Imperial) *palace*; *mansion* → *prince/princess*; (Shinto) *shrine*.
室也。从宀，躳省聲。凡宮之屬皆从宮。
辛# needle/cutting tool + 宀 roof/building → *oversee* food preparation indoors, including the cutting of meat → *manage*; *control*.
辠人在屋下執事者。从宀从辛。辛，辠也。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines 丯# as described in 契 (cut through and separate) + 口 mouth → *harm* or *damage* caused by something cut/bitten through and thus separated → *prevent*/*hinder* (← prevent/hinder by separating). In the derivative characters 瞎 and 豁, the lower vertical stroke of 害 extends down to the 口 element.
傷也。从宀从口。宀、口，言从家起也。丯聲。
An abbreviated form# of 晏 (settle) + 宀 roof/building → settle in /down to an indoors *feast* or *banquet*. Compare 讌.
安也。从宀妟聲。
As per 肖# (resemble in miniature) + 宀 roof/building → rays of sunlight that stream indoors at dusk, growing ever finer → *early evening*; *night*.
夜也。从宀，宀下冥也；肖聲。

宀 roof/building + 豕 pig/boar, here a variant form of 亥# (pig/boar stretched taut for slaughter) → pigs/boars confined in a hut or shed and awaiting slaughter → *house*/*household* → *home*; *family*; *shop*; *store*; *business* → *dealer*; *seller*; *specialist* (← tradesman operating a particular business).
居也。从宀，豭省聲。
悉也。知宷諦也。从宀从釆。徐锴曰：“宀，覆也。釆，别也。包覆而深别之。宷，悉也。”

As per 辰# (twitch) + 宀 roof/building → *imperial palace* (or, a particular building located deep within palace confines, in either case, which causes those entering to twitch/tremble with awe or dread) → *language used with respect to the emperor*.
屋宇也。从宀辰聲。
As per 谷# (cavity) + 宀 roof/building → empty building into which voluminous goods are placed → *put in*; *contents*; *volume* → *contain*; *accept* → *appearance* (← shape of objects in a container).
盛也。从宀、谷。

The relevant oracle bone form of the element now written 百 shows two figures squeezed into a bed, that shrink in curling positions. 宿 adds an element combining 人 person and 宀 roof/building → (place to) curl up and sleep → *lodging*; *shelter* → *inn*. Also, *be pregnant* (← lodge a fetus). There is no etymological connection with 百.
止也。从宀𠈇聲。𠈇，古文夙。
同地爲寀。从宀采聲。
居之速也。从宀疌聲。
As per 叔# (slender and pendent) + 宀 roof/building → *desolate* building, where silence hangs in the air → *still*; *deserted*; *lonely* → *lacking*; *sad*.

As per 奇# (lean) + 宀 roof/building → *lean on* or *draw near*/toward a building → *approach*; *bring near*; *call at/upon*; *step aside* → *depend on*; *gather* (← call at another person's dwelling for food and shelter) → *add* (up to) (← gather). Also, *entrust* (← be entrusted with the care of others) and *send* (← have objects brought to another).
託也。从宀奇聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character combines 矢# arrow + a pair of hands → straighten an arrow. A seal inscription form adds 宀 roof/building, creating 寅, the original sense of which was to straighten/stretch and stand to one's full height, inside a building. *Tiger* (as the *third sign of the Chinese zodiac*) and *3 A.M. to 5 A.M.* are borrowed meanings.
髕也。正月，陽气動，去黃泉，欲上出，陰尚彊，象宀不達，髕寅於下也。凡寅之屬皆从寅。
As per 宓# (shut tight) + 山 mountain → mountain with dense vegetation, and tightly shut off from human access → *density* → *minute*; *be hidden*.
山如堂者。从山宓聲。
As per 完# (surround completely) + 攴 strike/hit → *bandits*/*thieves* surrounding their objects of attack → *enemies*; *invade*.
暴也。从攴从完。
As per 畐# as described in 副 (abundance) + 宀 roof/building → building stocked with *abundant* possessions → *wealthy*; *become wealthy*.
備也。一曰厚也。从宀畐聲。
安也。从宀，心在皿上。人之飲食器，所以安人。
臥驚病也。从㝱省，丙聲。
周垣也。从宀奐聲。
As per 未# (obscure) + an element combining 宀 roof/building and 爿 long, wooden sleeping pallet → *sleep* (← an obscure state of consciousness; compare 夢).
臥也。从㝱省，未聲。
臥也。从宀钅聲鲞。

The relevant seal inscription form is 宀# roof/building + an element combining piled bricks/stones and 廾 pair of hands → create layers of building materials in raising a shelter. Later, 氷/ 冫 ice was added at bottom to emphasize a structure offering protection from the *cold*.
凍也。从人在宀下，以茻薦覆之，下有仌。
As per 禺# (curve) + 宀 roof/building → curved, hut-like *temporary abode* → *stay/use temporarily*. Also, *do under the pretext of* (← temporary expedient).
寄也。从宀禺聲。
As per 是# (straight) + 宀 roof/building → straight pillars supporting a roof → *truly*; *honestly* (← logical/ethical rectitude).
止也。从宀是聲。
水。出魏郡武安，東北入呼沱水。从水𡩠聲。𡩠，籒文𡪢字。
As per 眞# (fullness) + 宀 roof/building → (store)house filled with possessions → *place* within; *put/set* in place.
As per 莫# (concealed) + 宀 roof/building → *quiet*, concealed dwelling → *lonely*.

As per 祭# (scrape) + 宀 roof/building → rub a building spotless, eliminating all dirt. *Observe* is an associated meaning (← observe/inspect that which has been cleaned) → *investigate*; *judge*; *estimate*. Also, *be considerate of* and *profound*.
覆也。从宀、祭。
無禮居也。从宀婁聲。
The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows a child with a large head + 宀 roof/building → a solitary child (compare 孤) indoors → *alone* → *widow*; *few*; *minimal*.
少也。从宀从頒。頒，分賦也，故爲少。

The addition of 宀 roof/building to 侵 (deep) indicated a room crammed deep into the corner of a house. 寢 combines an abbreviated form# of this element + 爿 long, wooden sleeping pallet → *lie down*/*sleep* in a *back/inner room* → *lay down*; *go to bed*. Also, *leave* (unused).
臥驚也。一曰小兒號寣寣。一曰河内相𧦝也。从㝱省，从言。

As per 吾# (crossing) + an abbreviated form of 寢 sleep → *awaken* (← crossing point between states of consciousness). *Clarity* may be regarded either as an extended sense, or as a borrowed meaning via 悟.
寐覺而有信曰寤。从㝱省，吾聲。一曰晝見而夜㝱也。
As per 翏# (separate from a main unit) + 宀 roof/building → *empty* building, one separated from a main structure → *vacant*; *deserted*; *lonely*.

The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows that the element at the bottom# was originally not 貫 but a combination of 貝 commodities and 周 (an enclosure). The addition of 宀 roof/building yields the meaning "house full of treasures" → *be filled (with)* → *seed*; *berry*; *fruit*; *nut*; *content*; *substance*; *ingredients* (← fill) → *bear fruit*. Also, *actuality* and *sincerity* (← fully true content; compare 眞).
富也。从宀从貫。貫，貨貝也。

寍# is 宀 roof/building + an element combining 心 heart/emotions and 皿 dish/plate/bowl → settle into a relaxed position while partaking of food indoors. 寧 alters 皿 into 罒 and adds 丂 as described in 号 (extend then bend) → settle oneself in a relaxed posture, with a plate of food alongside → *quiet*; *peaceful*. *Rather* is a borrowed meaning.
願詞也。从丂寍聲。
An abbreviated form# of 塞 fortress/fort + 木 tree/wood → (wooden) *fort/stronghold* or *stockade*.
As per 番# (spread) + 宀 roof/building → spread out in searching a building for something concealed → *investigate* → *judge*.
屋皃。从宀爲聲。
Variant# of 舃 (double/pile up) + 宀 roof/building → pile goods indoors → *copy*; *duplicate*; *transcribe* (← pile atop). Also, *photograph*, *project* (on) and *transfer/move*.
置物也。从宀舄聲。

The relevant seal inscription form of the lower element# is a depiction of a mountain goat with widely spaced horns. 寬 adds 宀 roof/building → *spacious* building in which one can relax → *magnanimous*; *generous* (← broad-minded).
屋寬大也。从宀萈聲。
As per 尞# as described in 僚 (circular continuum) + 宀 roof/building → a circular structure (or, a circular group of buildings) → *government office*; *dormitory*.
As per 睘# as described in 環 (circular) + 宀 roof/building → *the world*, wrapped about by the vast sky (compare 圜). Also, an *enclosed parcel of land* within an imperial domain.
王者封畿内縣也。从宀瞏聲。
瞑言也。从㝱省，臬聲。
至也。从宀親聲。
龍# dragon + 宀 roof/building → lavish attention on a confined dragon → *cherish*; *favor*; *favorite*; *affection*. Here, as in 龕, 龍 may be understood as representing a treasured possession.
尊居也。从宀龍聲。

This character was written with a combination of many different elements before 寶 was settled upon as the standard form. Among these combinations, most of the forms featured both 宀 roof/building and 貝 commodities. The phonetic similarity to 富 suggests that the original idea of the character that came to be written 寶 was that of 富, namely, a building stocked with abundant possessions → *treasure* → *currency* → *cherish*.
珍也。从宀从王从貝，缶聲。
大屋也。从宀豐聲。《易》曰：“寷其屋。”

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 又 hand + a line, indicating a hand or (thin) finger settled upon another object (such as in taking a person's pulse) → *unit of measurement* (approximately that of a finger). In characters such as 耐 將 寺 尋 and 導, 寸 functions as an action indicator.
十分也。人手卻一寸，動𧖴，謂之寸口。从又从一。凡寸之屬皆从寸。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 止# (stand straight) + 寸 hand/action indicator → stand straight by in attending on a superior, then carry out orders → government office (← place where official functions are carried out). (Buddhist) *temple* is via the name ( 鴻臚寺) of a reception building for priestly visitors from outside of China.
廷也。有法度者也。从寸之聲。
五指持也。从𠬪一聲。讀若律。
